activity_summary: At nine you rose. Asked where it pained you, you said it was in the head, and that there was a city in it. You left the glass with Richard. The slate stayed forgiven.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Kept the glass, and let you go.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Noted the hour, and cleared the way.

entities.name: Agnes Tipping
entities.context: Asked the question, and kept the forgiveness to one night.

facets.activity: Rose at nine and said the pain was a city

quotes.speaker: agnes_tipping
quotes.text: Where does it pain you tonight, Will?

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: In the head. There's a city in it.
